verdict.rationale: Zapier's docs mention AI-generated troubleshooting instructions and a help article on diagnosing common Zap errors, but there's no evidence of dedicated error-handling branches/workflows or automatic failure notifications being a first-class, documented feature — only reactive troubleshooting guidance is shown. missing for 10: documentation of built-in failure-notification settings, dedicated error-path/branching workflow configuration, and independent confirmation these work in practice.
